Subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II report & bridge-letter request — audit window clarification (Horizon AI)

Hi Elena / Horizon security team,

Hope you're well — I'm Soojin on the Redwood security intake team. We're starting a routine intake for Horizon AI as part of our procurement & vendor assurance process. Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and (if applicable) a short bridge letter or statement to cover any audit period gaps?

What we need from you to keep the intake moving:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the period you expect (please state the exact start/end dates on the report).
- If the report period doesn't fully align with our requested coverage window (Oct 1, 2026 — Sep 30, 2027), a bridge letter or complementary statement that:
  - Confirms control continuity for the gap period, and
  - Notes any exceptions or key changes (if any).
- A minimal list of sample artifacts we may request later (e.g., policy snapshots, ACL examples, sample audit logs) — we won't ask for full production datasets.

Secure transfer options we accept: pre-signed S3 link, SFTP (dropbox-style), or encrypted ZIP via your transfer partner. If you prefer, we can generate a pre-signed S3 URL — see quick transfer note below.

Quick transfer note (optional): if you want a presigned S3 upload from us, reply with the filenames you plan to upload and we'll generate short-lived credentials.

A few practical notes to speed review:
- Redactions: we accept redacted PII. If you redact, please provide a short metadata note indicating which sections were redacted and why.
- Evidence scope: we're primarily validating control design and operational continuity; we frequently request a small sample of logs (auth, access provisioning) and policy snapshots.
- Delivery timeline: if possible, please confirm availability by EOB Fri Jan 13 so we can schedule any follow-ups before our review window.

Attached below are two short templates to help accelerate a reply (I will attach a bridge-letter template and transfer instructions in follow up). If you'd like a one-line procurement reply we can send to your vendor/ procurement team, I've included a short snippet at the end.

Procurement one-liner (copy/paste):
- "We can provide our SOC 2 Type II report for [audit period]. We'll upload to the secure link provided by Redwood (or send via SFTP)."

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Intake
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

--
Attachments (to follow): Redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, transfer_instructions.txt

From: Elena Gomez <security@horizonai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SOC 2 Type II report & bridge-letter request — audit window clarification (Horizon AI)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to share. A few clarifying points before we upload:  

1) Audit window: our current Type II attestation covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31 (reported as 01 Jan 2027 — 31 Dec 2027). I see your preferred window is 01 Oct 2026 — 30 Sep 2027. We have two options on our side:
   - Provide our Type II report plus a bridge letter confirming controls for Oct–Dec 2026, or
   - Offer targeted evidence for Oct–Dec 2026 (policy snapshots + selected logs) in lieu of a formal bridge.

2) Bridge letter content: can you confirm whether a short management attestation (1 page) confirming continuity and no material control changes would be acceptable, or do you require auditor-signed wording?

3) Redaction guidance: we will redact customer PII and internal account IDs. Does Redwood need a redaction manifest for each file?

4) Transfer: we can upload to a presigned S3 link. We also have our auditor's redaction-friendly PDF of the report (HorizonAI_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf) which we can attach now if that's okay.

If those options work, we'll plan to upload the report and a draft bridge letter for your review. Timeline: we can deliver the report immediately and the bridge draft by Jan 18.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Gomez
Security & Compliance Manager
Horizon AI
security@horizonai.com

Thanks, Elena — that timeline works. To confirm a couple of points so we can close the intake quickly: 

- Bridge letter: a short management attestation is usually sufficient for our procurement review. Auditor-signed language is appreciated but not required at intake — if an auditor statement is available, include it. The attestation should explicitly name the gap period (Oct 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026) and state whether controls remained operational with no material exceptions.

- Redaction manifest: yes, please include a brief manifest (one paragraph or a separate file) that lists what was redacted (e.g., "removed PII in sections 3.2 and 4.1 — account IDs replaced with XXX"). That helps our reviewers.

- Evidence sampling: if you choose to provide targeted evidence for Oct–Dec 2026 instead of a bridge, we typically request:
  - A policy snapshot (access management, change control) dated within the gap period,
  - One week of auth logs (sample) with hashed account identifiers, and
  - A short note describing any control changes between Oct–Dec 2026 and Jan 2027.

I've attached a short bridge-letter template and transfer instructions to speed things up. You can upload the report and any artifacts to the presigned S3 URL below; if you prefer SFTP we can share credentials.

Presigned S3 (example): s3://redwood-inference-secure-transfer/requests/horizonai/2028-01-presign — we will send a short-lived POST policy once you confirm filenames.

Bridge-letter template (copy/paste):

[Company letterhead]
Date: [date]
To: Redwood Inference Security Team
Re: Attestation of control continuity for Oct 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026

We hereby attest that the control environment described in Horizon AI's SOC 2 Type II report for the period Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2027 was in operation and materially unchanged for the period Oct 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026. There were no known material exceptions that would alter the effectiveness of the controls relevant to Redwood Inference's security and availability needs.

Signed,
Name
Title
Horizon AI

One-line procurement reply (snippets you can forward internally):
- "Horizon will upload the SOC 2 Type II report (Jan–Dec 2027) and provide a short management attestation covering Oct–Dec 2026."

If you upload the report with any redactions, please include the redaction manifest as a separate text file so our reviewers can confirm scope.

Appreciate it — let me know if you'd like our team to review your draft bridge letter once uploaded.

Best,
Soojin
